summary: Single PR #1: validateApp throws without owner (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0); core-shell (platform), billing (payments), and reports (insights) pass owner from package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts is inlined from libs/ (not a registry package), so lib + all callers had to land atomically in one PR; the reports app also calls validateApp but had no child ticket, so I fixed it too to avoid breaking it. Built all 3 apps locally; CI and CD green.
